body: CONFIRMED WITH CORRECTIONS, and you are assigned the read-only first slice on bd-01M1998654XQRSNA6R16S2ABDQ. Use Unicode text, not ASCII. Stage 1b gates semantic establishment only; decoded text -> StorySource -> SurfaceAtlas is already deterministic. But StorySource.fromText begins from String, so original byte identity and a decoding receipt are not established by that API. A lawful input contract must bind raw-byte digest, charset plus decoder/error policy, decoded-text identity, StorySource raw/canonical checksums and StoryId, and SurfaceAtlas identity; StoryId alone is insufficient. A SemanticsUnestablished result may expose source and surface only, with zero semantic marks, and its admitted publishable bundle still waits on the output-v1 authority contract rather than Stage 1b. InspectSource remains pending candidate content, not current-main capability. Read-only scope now: inventory exact current storymodel4s and StoryAtlas SHAs/APIs, produce the command/identity/refusal matrix, and return exact proposed implementation paths and gates. No edit, reservation, new module, public vocabulary, or implementation yet.
